title: network_mode: host on Docker Desktop for Mac does not expose the app on the Mac's localhost
symptoms: curl localhost:3000 on the Mac is refused while the container logs show the server listening
Port mappings are discarded when the service uses host networking
cause: On Docker Desktop, host networking means the Linux VM's network unless the opt-in host networking feature is on. That feature needs Desktop 4.34 or later, works only at layer 4 for Linux containers, and is off by default.
fix: Publish ports with -p or ports instead of host networking, or turn the feature on in settings on 4.34 or later.
apply: Docker Desktop > Settings > Resources > Network > Enable host networking > Apply and restart
affected: Docker Desktop for Mac and Windows; unsupported before 4.34, opt-in from 4.34 (2024)
